rows.TEXT_M: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.
rows.TEXT_F: In her youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. She then became sovereign of her realm.

rows.TEXT_M: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.
rows.TEXT_F: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

rows.TEXT_M: Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
rows.TEXT_F: Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

rows.TEXT_M: Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
rows.TEXT_F: Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

rows.TEXT_M: A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.
rows.TEXT_F: A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without her knowledge.
